summary.title: Git Immersion
summary.one_liner: A guided, hands-on tour of Git fundamentals for learning distributed version control by doing.
takeaways: Git Immersion is a guided tour of Git's fundamentals.
The approach is hands-on: learn Git by using its utilities and operations directly.
Git is described as a powerful distributed version control system.
summary.summary: Git Immersion is a guided tour that walks through the fundamentals of Git, based on the idea that knowing something means doing it. The page describes Git as a powerful, sophisticated distributed version control system and argues that the best way to master it is to experience its utilities and operations first-hand. It links to a "Start Git Immersion" entry point, but the page text itself does not list specific lessons, prerequisites, or topics covered.
